LanguageData.RR_AssembleMachineGate.label: assemble gate section
LanguageData.RR_AssembleMachineGate.description:
Physically carry 25 steel and 2 industrial components to a machining table set to gate control, then complete one section of the installation. A gate is four sections: run them one after another on one bench, or at the same time on up to four benches linked to the gate.
Designate the door, communications console, battery and machining table in Operations first. The table retains its ordinary recipes.
